## Only for SOP or docs changes (anything under `apps/docs`)

SOP(s) affected:

- [ ] Document control table, version number, and revision history are updated
- [ ] New SOP added to the SOP Library table and to the folder's `_meta.js`
- [ ] I checked the Vercel preview link
- [ ] I worked through the [Before you publish](https://github.com/grantmx/grithub/blob/main/apps/docs/content/contributing/before-you-publish.md) checklist: no personal information, no secrets, no internal-only links, I have the right to share everything here
